description:
KithError in kith-core/src/error.rs has two variants that carry a String instead of a structured source error:

```
Store(String),       // line 29
Validation(String),  // line 31
```

The db_err() helper in kith-store/src/lib.rs (line 1211) converts rusqlite::Error to String via .to_string(), discarding the original error type and making programmatic matching impossible.

Fix: Add a From<rusqlite::Error> to KithError (possibly via a KithStoreError newtype), or at minimum change Store(String) → Store(#[from] rusqlite::Error) with the rusqlite dep promoted to kith-core. The Validation variant similarly should carry a more structured type rather than a bare String.

Impact: all match arms on KithError::Store currently pattern-match on a string message, which is fragile.
title: KithError::Store/Validation wrap String not source error
